source_policy: Existing GIER original training pool, visually selected and balanced by scene. Fit uses prior diagnostic sources; held originals exclude all available protected and earlier diagnostic groups, subject to pixel isolation.

review.complete: Clearly discernible change in requested global tonal contrast, retaining specified visible detail and colour; no conspicuous veil, excessive darkening, clipping, noise, colour shift or brightness change that dominates the contrast edit.
review.method: Codex compares blinded columns at matched size and native pixel crops. Exactly one rendered candidate per semantic instruction, reused across aligned translations. No language accuracy implied.
